title: "Projects"

This page collects selected research and engineering projects developed during my PhD.

## Terrain-aware MPPI Navigation

Reactive local navigation for unmanned ground vehicles using 2.5D terrain maps, learned guidance and MPPI-based predictive control.

**Status:** in development  
**Topics:** field robotics, MPPI, terrain mapping, ROS 2, UGV navigation

## RGB-T Onboard Perception for UGVs

Real-time RGB-T perception pipeline for search and rescue robotics using onboard embedded computing, RGB cameras, thermal cameras and ROS 2.

**Status:** IROS 2026 related work  
**Topics:** robotic perception, RGB-T, Jetson, ROS 2, search and rescue

## 2.5D Map Compression

Local map management and intelligent compression of 2.5D elevation maps for long-term navigation with limited onboard resources.

**Status:** prototype  
**Topics:** mapping, compression, embedded robotics, terrain representation

## ROS 2 Robotics Infrastructure

Docker-based development environments and deployment tools for ROS 2, Gazebo, Jetson, perception pipelines and multi-machine robotic systems.

**Status:** ongoing  
**Topics:** ROS 2, Docker, CycloneDDS, Jetson, robotics software
